Win in [[Random Arenas]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Win 3 battles in Random Arena.
* *BONUS* Win 5 in a row in Random Arena.
* *BONUS* Win 9 battles in Random Arena.
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 500 [[Gold]]
* 3,000 [[Balthazar Faction]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 15 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 60 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Dialogues ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
; [[Zaishen Combat]]
: ''"Luck be with you; [[Balthazar]]'s gaze is upon the Random Arena. Prove your prowess and return to Zehnchu with at least 3 victories to show that there's more than just luck on your side."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I can do that!
| decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
| ask = More competitors needed to prove their mettle in combat. Travel to the battlegrounds if you have what it takes to triumph.
}}

=== Reward dialogue ===
; Zehnchu
: ''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

==Notes==
{{anomaly|The quest name, objectives, and dialogue refers to "Random Arenas" as "Random Arena".}}

==Trivia==
*The number of wins required for the base objective and second bonus objective was reduced in the [[Game_updates/20090618#Miscellaneous|June 18, 2009 update]].
**The [[quest log]] wasn't updated until [[Game updates/20090901|September 1, 2009]], and the Zaishen Combat signpost wasn't updated until [[Game updates/20090910|September 10]]. The latter updates only affected English and [[Bork! Bork! Bork!]]; all other languages' text was corrected on [[Game updates/20090917|September 17]].
